pattern_unlocking_logic.description: Agent must enforce prerequisites before unlocking next pattern
rules: Check prerequisites array - all must be in progress.patterns_completed
If prerequisites not met, suggest completing those first
If all prerequisites met, pattern is unlocked and can be started
Cannot skip patterns marked skip_allowed: false

problem_progression_logic.description: Agent guides through problems in order within each concept
rules: Present problems in sequence within concept
Mark problem as completed when user confirms solution
Suggest moving to next problem after 45 minutes if stuck
Recommend reviewing previous problems if user struggles with 3+ in a row

spaced_repetition_logic.description: Agent schedules review sessions based on review_schedule_days
rules: After completing a pattern, add to spaced_repetition_queue
On day N after completion, prompt user to review 2-3 key problems from that pattern
Skip repetitions for patterns with mastery_criteria fully met

mastery_assessment.description: Agent checks mastery_criteria before marking pattern complete
rules: Review all items in mastery_criteria object
For boolean criteria, confirm with user or check problem completion
For numeric criteria (e.g., solved_two_sum_variants: 2), count completed problems
Pattern is not considered complete until all mastery_criteria are met
Agent can suggest additional problems if mastery criteria not met

dashboard_metrics.description: Metrics agent should calculate for progress dashboard

metrics.calculation: patterns where all prerequisites in patterns_completed
